function rvSpin(r,dir,hard){if(r.inc>0&&!hard)return;r.inc=hard?2.8:2.2;r.dur=r.inc;r.yt=dir*(hard?2.6+Math.random()*.9:.8+Math.random()*.9);r.sd=dir;r.cool=10+Math.random()*8;r.dmg=Math.min(1,(r.dmg||0)+(hard?.14:.07))}
function rvStep(h){const base=STG[S.stage].pv*DIF[S.dif].pm/VF,mist=[2,1.6,1.25,1,.8][S.dif];
 RV.forEach(r=>{const i=Math.min(N-1,r.s/DS|0),f=Math.min(1,r.s/DS-i);
  if(r.ph===undefined){r.ph=Math.random()*6.28;r.dmg=0;r.inc=0;r.yaw=0;r.yt=0;r.dl=0;r.cool=8+Math.random()*10;r.sm=0;r.dur=1;r.sd=1}
  /* driver mistakes: random slides / spin-outs, more often at lower difficulty */
  if(!r.d&&S.mode==='race'&&r.inc<=0){r.cool-=h;if(r.cool<=0&&r.s>DS*25){const c=Math.abs(ang(HD[Math.min(N,i+6)]-HD[Math.max(0,i-6)]));
    if(Math.random()<h*.014*mist*(1+c*4))rvSpin(r,Math.random()<.5?-1:1,false);else r.cool=.5}}
  let sf=1-.5*r.dmg;
  if(r.inc>0){r.inc-=h;const u=Math.max(0,r.inc/r.dur);sf*=.2+(1-u)*.55;r.yaw+=(r.yt-r.yaw)*Math.min(1,h*4);r.dl+=r.sd*h*(u>.35?2.2:0);r.dl=clamp(r.dl,-HW*.8,HW*.8);
   if(r.inc<=0){r.yt=0}
   try{if(Math.random()<h*30){const q=r.g.position;pAdd(SMK,q.x,q.y+.4,q.z,(Math.random()-.5),1,(Math.random()-.5),1,.75,.72,.68,.6,2.2)}}catch(e){}}
  else{r.yaw+=(0-r.yaw)*Math.min(1,h*2.5);r.dl*=1-Math.min(1,h*.9)}
  /* inexact driving: lane wobble and small steering twitches */
  const wob=Math.sin(S.t*.85+r.ph)*.45+Math.sin(S.t*2.3+r.ph*2)*.22,tw=Math.sin(S.t*3.1+r.ph*3)*.05*(1+(r.inc>0?2:0));
  if(!r.d){const gm=r.s-st.idx*DS,rb=gm>0?1-Math.min(gm/150,.18):1+Math.min(-gm/500,.03);r.v+=(VC[i]*base*r.k*rb*sf*(1-Math.abs(wob)*.03)-r.v)*Math.min(1,h*1.4);if(i>=N-5){r.d=1;r.tf=S.t}}else r.v*=1-Math.min(1,h*.8);r.s+=r.v*h;
  /* damaged cars smoke */
  if(r.dmg>.22){r.sm+=h*r.dmg*28;while(r.sm>1){r.sm--;try{const q=r.g.position,g=Math.max(.1,.7-.5*r.dmg);pAdd(SMK,q.x,q.y+.95,q.z,(Math.random()-.5)*.6,1.3,(Math.random()-.5)*.6,1.1,g,g,g,.5,2.2)}catch(e){}}}
  const a=P[i],b=P[i+1],t=TG[i],ln=r.ln+wob+r.dl;r.g.position.set(a.x+(b.x-a.x)*f+t.z*ln,a.y+.12,a.z+(b.z-a.z)*f-t.x*ln);r.g.rotation.set(0,HD[i]+r.yaw+tw,r.yaw*.05)})}

function mtJump(){MT.s=DS*(10+Math.random()*Math.max(10,N*.5-10));const i=Math.max(1,Math.min(N-3,Math.floor(MT.s/DS)));MT.gy=P[i].y+.12;MT.air=0;MT.vy=0;mtShot()}
function mtShot(first){
 let k;do{k=(Math.random()*7)|0}while(k===MT.sh&&!first);
 MT.sh=k;MT.shT=0;MT.sd=Math.random()<.5?-1:1;MT.shA=Math.random()*6.28;MT.snap=1;MT.dur=[7,12,4.5,6.5,5,3.8,6.5][k]+Math.random()*2.5;

  MT.cs=cs;MT.fx=p.x+t.z*o;MT.fz=p.z-t.x*o;MT.fy=p.y+1+Math.random()}}
function mtDrive(dt){
 let i=Math.max(1,Math.min(N-3,Math.floor(MT.s/DS)));
 const kap=ang(HD[Math.min(N,i+3)]-HD[Math.max(0,i-3)])/(6*DS),tv=Math.min(50,VC[i]*MT.k);
 MT.v+=(tv-MT.v)*Math.min(1,dt*1.6);MT.s+=MT.v*dt;
 if(MT.s>=(N-8)*DS){mtJump();i=Math.max(1,Math.min(N-3,Math.floor(MT.s/DS)))}
 const f=clamp(MT.s/DS-i,0,1),a=P[i],b=P[i+1],t=TG[i],lane=Math.sin(MT.s*.013)*HW*.28,
  x=a.x+(b.x-a.x)*f+t.z*lane,z=a.z+(b.z-a.z)*f-t.x*lane,yg=a.y+(b.y-a.y)*f+.12,hp=HD[i]+ang(HD[i+1]-HD[i])*f;
 const gv=(STG[MT.stage].dop||0)>.06?1:.5,sT=clamp(kap*MT.v*.5*gv,-.5,.5);MT.sl+=(sT-MT.sl)*Math.min(1,dt*3.2);
 const G=24;
 if(MT.air){MT.vy-=G*dt;MT.gy+=MT.vy*dt;if(MT.gy<=yg){MT.gy=yg;MT.air=0;if(MT.vy<-3){st.land=1;shake=Math.max(shake,.7)}MT.vy=0}}
 else{const vy=(yg-MT.gy)/Math.max(dt,.004),fy=MT.gy+MT.vy*dt-.5*G*dt*dt;
  if(yg<fy-.04&&MT.vy>-6){MT.air=1;MT.vy-=G*dt;MT.gy=fy}else{MT.gy=yg;MT.vy+=(vy-MT.vy)*Math.min(1,dt*14)}}
 const tp=MT.air?-Math.atan2(MT.vy,Math.max(MT.v,8))*.9:-Math.atan2(P[i+2].y-P[i].y,2*DS);
 MT.tp+=(clamp(tp,-.45,.45)-MT.tp)*Math.min(1,dt*7);
 const hv=hp+MT.sl;
 st.x=x;st.z=z;st.y=MT.gy;st.h=hv;st.pb=MT.tp;st.pp=0;st.sp=0;st.rr=clamp(kap*MT.v*MT.v*.004,-.06,.06)*(MT.air?.2:1);
 st.vl=MT.v;st.spd=MT.v;st.slip=Math.abs(MT.sl)*MT.v*.8;st.off=false;st.idx=i;st.steer=clamp(((hp-hv)+kap*2.6)/.45,-1,1);
 MT.hp=hp;MT.i=i}
function mtMv(tg,sp,dt){if(MT.snap)cam.position.copy(tg);else cam.position.lerp(tg,1-Math.exp(-dt*sp))}
function mtCam(dt){
 if(MT.sh===1?(MT.s>MT.cs+22||MT.shT>12):MT.shT>MT.dur)mtShot();
 const hp=MT.hp,px=Math.sin(hp),pz=Math.cos(hp),fx=Math.sin(st.h),fz=Math.cos(st.h),sd=MT.sd,T=MT.shT,v=MT.v,A=mtA;let fov=58;MT.gr=true;
 switch(MT.sh){
  case 0:{const w=Math.sin(T*.5)*1.7;A.set(st.x-px*7.2+pz*w,st.y+2+Math.sin(T*.7)*.35,st.z-pz*7.2-px*w);mtMv(A,10,dt);cam.lookAt(st.x+px*3,st.y+1,st.z+pz*3);fov=60+Math.min(v,50)*.25;break}
  case 1:{cam.position.set(MT.fx,MT.fy,MT.fz);cam.lookAt(st.x,st.y+.7,st.z);fov=clamp(2*Math.atan(3.4/Math.max(cam.position.distanceTo(A.set(st.x,st.y,st.z)),6))*57.3,12,52);break}
  case 2:{A.set(st.x+px*7.4+pz*sd*1.7,st.y+.95,st.z+pz*7.4-px*sd*1.7);mtMv(A,12,dt);cam.lookAt(st.x,st.y+.7,st.z);fov=64;break}
  case 3:{const a=T*.3*sd+MT.shA;A.set(st.x+Math.cos(a)*13-px*5,st.y+13+Math.sin(T*.5)*2.5,st.z+Math.sin(a)*13-pz*5);mtMv(A,4,dt);cam.lookAt(st.x,st.y+.4,st.z);fov=54;break}
  case 4:{MT.gr=false;cam.position.set(st.x+fx*2.1,st.y+.82,st.z+fz*2.1);cam.lookAt(st.x+fx*25,st.y+.9+st.pb*8,st.z+fz*25);fov=80;break}
  case 5:{const o=2.7+Math.sin(T*.9)*.35,fo=1.6+Math.sin(T*.7)*1.2;A.set(st.x+fz*sd*o+fx*fo,st.y+.45,st.z-fx*sd*o+fz*fo);mtMv(A,14,dt);cam.lookAt(st.x+fx*1.4,st.y+.4,st.z+fz*1.4);fov=52;break}
  default:{const a=hp+Math.PI+T*.5*sd,r=6.3+Math.sin(T*.6)*1.1;A.set(st.x+Math.sin(a)*r,st.y+1.3+Math.sin(T*.8)*.6,st.z+Math.cos(a)*r);mtMv(A,7,dt);cam.lookAt(st.x+px*1.5,st.y+.8,st.z+pz*1.5);fov=56}
 }
 MT.snap=0;MT.fov=fov}

function fAt(t){const q=clamp(t*30,0,RP.length/FR-1.001),i=Math.floor(q),f=q-i,o=i*FR,n=o+FR;return k=>RP[o+k]+(RP[n+k]-RP[o+k])*f}

  try{if(RP[o+20]>.22&&Math.random()<.6)pAdd(SMK,g(15),g(18)+.9,g(16),(Math.random()-.5)*.6,1.3,(Math.random()-.5)*.6,1.1,.3,.3,.3,.55,2.4);if(RP[o+21]&&Math.random()<.4)pAdd(FIR,g(15),g(18)+.7,g(16),(Math.random()-.5)*.5,1.8,(Math.random()-.5)*.5,.6,1,.55,.1,.6,1)}catch(e){}}}

function rpCam(dt,fx,fz){const V=THREE.Vector3,c=RPC.cam,rx=fz,rz=-fx,sn=RPC.snap;RPC.snap=0;

/* ---------- soft particle systems (sparks / smoke / fire) ---------- */
function mkPS(n,add,grav,bounce,ce){
 const o={n,c:0,pos:new Float32Array(n*3),vel:new Float32Array(n*3),col:new Float32Array(n*3),c0:new Float32Array(n*3),al:new Float32Array(n),sz:new Float32Array(n),s0:new Float32Array(n),gr:new Float32Array(n),life:new Float32Array(n),max:new Float32Array(n),grav,bounce,ce};
 for(let i=0;i<n;i++)o.pos[i*3+1]=-9999;
 const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
 g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.BufferAttribute(o.pos,3));g.setAttribute('color',new THREE.BufferAttribute(o.col,3));
 g.setAttribute('al',new THREE.BufferAttribute(o.al,1));g.setAttribute('sz',new THREE.BufferAttribute(o.sz,1));
 o.mat=new THREE.ShaderMaterial({uniforms:{sc:{value:300}},transparent:true,depthWrite:false,blending:add?THREE.AdditiveBlending:THREE.NormalBlending,
  vertexShader:'attribute vec3 color;attribute float al;attribute float sz;uniform float sc;varying vec3 vc;varying float va;void main(){vc=color;va=al;vec4 mv=modelViewMatrix*vec4(position,1.0);gl_PointSize=min(sz*sc/max(-mv.z,.5),56.0);gl_Position=projectionMatrix*mv;}',
  fragmentShader:'varying vec3 vc;varying float va;void main(){float d=length(gl_PointCoord-.5);float a=smoothstep(.5,.12,d)*va;if(a<.01)discard;gl_FragColor=vec4(vc,a);}'});
 o.mesh=new THREE.Points(g,o.mat);o.mesh.frustumCulled=false;o.mesh.renderOrder=3;o.g=g;scene.add(o.mesh);return o}
const SPK=mkPS(300,true,16,true,[1,.3,.05]),SMK=mkPS(110,false,-1.1,false,null),FIR=mkPS(70,true,-3,false,[.9,.12,0]);
const XPS=[SPK,SMK,FIR];
function pAdd(S_,x,y,z,vx,vy,vz,life,r,g,b,size,grow){const i=S_.c=(S_.c+1)%S_.n,k=i*3;S_.pos[k]=x;S_.pos[k+1]=y;S_.pos[k+2]=z;S_.vel[k]=vx;S_.vel[k+1]=vy;S_.vel[k+2]=vz;S_.life[i]=S_.max[i]=life;
 S_.c0[k]=S_.col[k]=r;S_.c0[k+1]=S_.col[k+1]=g;S_.c0[k+2]=S_.col[k+2]=b;S_.s0[i]=S_.sz[i]=size;S_.gr[i]=grow;S_.al[i]=1}
function pUpd(S_,dt,gy){let any=0;
 for(let i=0;i<S_.n;i++){if(S_.life[i]<=0)continue;any=1;const k=i*3,l=S_.life[i]-=dt;
  if(l<=0){S_.pos[k+1]=-9999;S_.al[i]=0;continue}
  const u=1-l/S_.max[i];S_.vel[k+1]-=S_.grav*dt;
  S_.pos[k]+=S_.vel[k]*dt;S_.pos[k+1]+=S_.vel[k+1]*dt;S_.pos[k+2]+=S_.vel[k+2]*dt;
  if(S_.bounce&&S_.pos[k+1]<gy&&S_.vel[k+1]<0){S_.pos[k+1]=gy;S_.vel[k+1]*=-.35;S_.vel[k]*=.7;S_.vel[k+2]*=.7}
  if(S_.ce){S_.col[k]=S_.c0[k]+(S_.ce[0]-S_.c0[k])*u;S_.col[k+1]=S_.c0[k+1]+(S_.ce[1]-S_.c0[k+1])*u;S_.col[k+2]=S_.c0[k+2]+(S_.ce[2]-S_.c0[k+2])*u;S_.al[i]=1-u*u}
  else S_.al[i]=(u<.15?u/.15:1)*(1-u)*.6;
  S_.sz[i]=Math.max(.02,S_.s0[i]+S_.gr[i]*u)}
 if(any||S_.dirty){S_.g.attributes.position.needsUpdate=true;S_.g.attributes.color.needsUpdate=true;S_.g.attributes.al.needsUpdate=true;S_.g.attributes.sz.needsUpdate=true;S_.dirty=any}}
function xClearPS(){XPS.forEach(S_=>{for(let i=0;i<S_.n;i++){S_.life[i]=0;S_.pos[i*3+1]=-9999;S_.al[i]=0}S_.dirty=1})}
function xSc(fov,h){const sc=h*.5/Math.tan(fov*Math.PI/360);XPS.forEach(S_=>S_.mat.uniforms.sc.value=sc)}

function xDent(lx,ly,lz,mag,dx,dz){

   const f=1-Math.sqrt(d2)/R,w=f*f*mag,h1=xhash(vx,vy,vz,1),h2=xhash(vx,vy,vz,2),h3=xhash(vx,vy,vz,3);
   let nx=a[k]+dx*w*(.55+h1*.9)+(h2-.5)*w*.7,ny=a[k+1]-w*.25*h3+(h1-.5)*w*.45,nz=a[k+2]+dz*w*(.55+h1*.9)+(h3-.5)*w*.7;
   const ox=nx-og[k],oy=ny-og[k+1],oz=nz-og[k+2],ln=Math.hypot(ox,oy,oz);
   if(ln>.75){const q=.75/ln;nx=og[k]+ox*q;ny=og[k+1]+oy*q;nz=og[k+2]+oz*q}
   a[k]=nx;a[k+1]=ny;a[k+2]=nz;
   if(c){const dk=1-.3*f;c[k]=Math.max(.2,c[k]*dk);c[k+1]=Math.max(.2,c[k+1]*dk);c[k+2]=Math.max(.2,c[k+2]*dk)}}

function xCrowdHit(){
 if(!XCR||S.mode!=='race'||st.spd<1.5)return;

  const dx=o.x-st.x,dz=o.z-st.z;if(dx>4||dx<-4||dz>4||dz<-4)continue;
  const fw=dx*fx+dz*fz,lt=dx*lx+dz*lz;

function crowdUpd(dt){if(!XCR)return;const p=XCR.p,t=performance.now()*.001,idx=st.idx,fast=st.spd>14&&S.mode==='race';let ch=0;
 for(let i=0;i<p.length;i++){const o=p[i];
  if(o.st===2)continue;
  if(o.st===1){o.t=(o.t||0)+dt;o.vy-=18*dt;o.x+=o.vx*dt;o.y+=o.vy*dt;o.z+=o.vz*dt;o.ax+=o.wx*dt;o.ay+=o.wy*dt;o.az+=o.wz*dt;
   if(o.y<o.gy+.22&&o.vy<0){o.y=o.gy+.22;o.vy*=-.3;o.vx*=.6;o.vz*=.6;o.wx*=.5;o.wy*=.5;o.wz*=.5;
    if(Math.hypot(o.vx,o.vz)<1.1&&Math.abs(o.vy)<1.3){o.st=2;o.ax=(Math.random()<.5?-1:1)*Math.PI/2;o.az=0;o.y=o.gy+.22;xPool(o.x,o.gy,o.z,.9+Math.random()*.4)}}
   crSet(i,o,0,t);ch=1;continue}
  if(o.pn>0){o.pn-=dt;o.tr-=dt;
   if(o.tr<=0){o.tr=.4+Math.random();o.rd=Math.random()<.5?o.rd+(Math.random()-.5)*2.6:Math.random()*6.283}
   if(Math.hypot(o.x-o.hx,o.z-o.hz)>38)o.rd=Math.atan2(o.hx-o.x,o.hz-o.z)+(Math.random()-.5)*.8;
   o.x+=Math.sin(o.rd)*o.rs*dt;o.z+=Math.cos(o.rd)*o.rs*dt;o.ry=o.rd;
   if((o.kt=(o.kt||0)-dt)<=0){o.kt=.25;o.k=near(o.x,o.z,Math.max(0,o.k-12),Math.min(N,o.k+12))}
   const dd=Math.hypot(P[o.k].x-o.x,P[o.k].z-o.z);o.gy=(dd<HW+.3?P[o.k].y+.12:P[o.k].by+hOff(dd,o.x,o.z))-.02;
   o.y=o.gy+Math.abs(Math.sin(t*13+o.ph))*.16;
   if(o.pn<=0){o.pn=0;o.ry=Math.atan2(P[o.k].x-o.x,P[o.k].z-o.z);o.y=o.gy}
   crSet(i,o,1,t*1.6);ch=1;continue}
  if(Math.abs(o.k-idx)>50)continue;
  const dx=o.x-st.x,dz=o.z-st.z,d=Math.hypot(dx,dz);
  if(fast&&o.cow&&!o.fl&&d<7&&Math.abs(o.k-idx)<14){o.fl=1.1}
  if(o.fl>0){o.fl-=dt;const r=Math.hypot(o.x-P[o.k].x,o.z-P[o.k].z)||1;o.x+=(o.x-P[o.k].x)/r*3.4*dt;o.z+=(o.z-P[o.k].z)/r*3.4*dt;o.fr=1;o.ry=Math.atan2(o.x-P[o.k].x,o.z-P[o.k].z)}else if(o.fr){o.fr=0;o.ry=Math.atan2(P[o.k].x-o.x,P[o.k].z-o.z)}
  const lv=clamp(1-d/45,0,1)*o.fan+(o.fl>0?.9:.18*o.fan);
  crSet(i,o,Math.min(1,lv),t);ch=1}
 if(ch)crFlush()}

function rvDent(g,lx,ly,lz,mag,dx,dz){const R=1.7,R2=R*R,dl=Math.hypot(dx,dz)||1;dx/=dl;dz/=dl;
 g.children.forEach(m=>{if(!m.isMesh||m.userData.xl||!m.geometry||m.geometry.type==='CircleGeometry')return;const ge=m.geometry,pa=ge.attributes.position;if(!pa)return;
  if(!m.userData.o0)m.userData.o0=new Float32Array(pa.array);const og=m.userData.o0,ca=ge.attributes.color,a=pa.array,c=ca&&ca.array,mp=m.position;
  for(let i=0,n=pa.count;i<n;i++){const k=i*3,vx=a[k]+mp.x,vy=a[k+1]+mp.y,vz=a[k+2]+mp.z,ex=vx-lx,ey=vy-ly,ez=vz-lz,d2=ex*ex+ey*ey+ez*ez;if(d2>R2)continue;
   const f=1-Math.sqrt(d2)/R,w=f*f*mag,h1=xhash(vx,vy,vz,1),h2=xhash(vx,vy,vz,2),h3=xhash(vx,vy,vz,3);
   let nx=a[k]+dx*w*(.55+h1*.9)+(h2-.5)*w*.7,ny=a[k+1]-w*.25*h3+(h1-.5)*w*.45,nz=a[k+2]+dz*w*(.55+h1*.9)+(h3-.5)*w*.7;
   const ox=nx-og[k],oy=ny-og[k+1],oz=nz-og[k+2],ln=Math.hypot(ox,oy,oz);if(ln>.75){const q=.75/ln;nx=og[k]+ox*q;ny=og[k+1]+oy*q;nz=og[k+2]+oz*q}
   a[k]=nx;a[k+1]=ny;a[k+2]=nz;
   if(c){const dk=1-.35*f;c[k]=Math.max(.2,c[k]*dk);c[k+1]=Math.max(.2,c[k+1]*dk);c[k+2]=Math.max(.2,c[k+2]*dk)}}
  pa.needsUpdate=true;if(ca)ca.needsUpdate=true})}
function rvRestore(g){g.children.forEach(m=>{const o=m.userData&&m.userData.o0;if(!o||!m.geometry)return;const ge=m.geometry;ge.attributes.position.array.set(o);ge.attributes.position.needsUpdate=true;if(ge.attributes.color){ge.attributes.color.array.fill(1);ge.attributes.color.needsUpdate=true}})}

function rvCrash(r,ty,pile){if(r.cr)return;const i=Math.min(N-1,r.s/DS|0),q=r.g.position,sd=(r.ln+r.dl>=0?1:-1)*(Math.random()<.3?-1:1);
 const c=r.cr={t:0,ty,cs:r.s,v:Math.max(r.v,9),cl:r.ln+r.dl,sd,yw:r.yaw||0,spin:(Math.random()<.5?-1:1)*(3.5+Math.random()*4),roll:0,dn:0,fire:Math.random()<.5,tl:0,end:6+Math.random()*4};
 c.tl=sd*(HW+4.5+Math.random()*3);
 if(ty==='crowd'&&XCR){let b=1e9;const t=TG[i];for(const o of XCR.p){if(Math.abs(o.k-i)>10)continue;const lat=(o.x-P[i].x)*t.z-(o.z-P[i].z)*t.x;if(lat*sd<0)continue;const d=Math.abs(o.k-i);if(d<b){b=d;c.tl=lat}}}
 if(ty==='block'){c.tl=c.cl*.25;c.end+=3}
 if(ty==='roll')c.tl=sd*(HW*.8+Math.random()*2);
 r.dmg=Math.min(1,(r.dmg||0)+(pile?.55:.7));
 try{for(let k=0;k<14;k++)pAdd(SMK,q.x,q.y+.5,q.z,(Math.random()-.5)*3,1.5,(Math.random()-.5)*3,1.2,.8,.8,.8,.7,2.4);xSparks(q.x,q.y+.3,q.z,0,0,26,1.6)}catch(e){}
 const d=Math.hypot(q.x-st.x,q.z-st.z);if(d<150){crashSfx(Math.max(2.5,9*(1-d/150)));xClang(clamp(1-d/150,.25,.9))}
 {const ri=RV.indexOf(r),tt={crowd:'Skidded into the crowd',roll:'Rolled over',block:'Spun across the road'}[ty],ti=pile?'PILE-UP':'RIVAL CRASH';
  if(ri===0)addHL('crash',ti,tt,RT-2.4,RT+4,38,4);else if(d<90)addHL('crash',ti,tt,RT-2.2,RT+3.4,34,0)}
 const ah=r.s-st.idx*DS;flash(pile?'PILE-UP!':'RIVAL CRASHED!',1100);
 if(ah>0&&ah<260)cap(ty==='block'?'Accident ahead! Car blocking the road!':'Rival crashed ahead — careful!','CO-DRIVER');
 try{shake=Math.max(shake,d<40?.4:0)}catch(e){}}
function rvAcc(h){if(S.mode!=='race'||!RV.length)return;const mist=[2,1.6,1.25,1,.8][S.dif];
 RV.forEach(r=>{
  if(r.nc===undefined)r.nc=(55+Math.random()*70)/mist;
  rvDmgApply(r.g,r.dmg||0);
  const i=Math.min(N-1,r.s/DS|0);
  if(!r.cr){if(r.d||r.s<DS*20)return;r.nc-=h;const q=r.g.position;
   for(const o of RV){if(o!==r&&o.cr&&Math.hypot(o.g.position.x-q.x,o.g.position.z-q.z)<4.8&&r.v>6){rvCrash(r,'roll',1);return}}
   if(r.nc<=0&&r.v>16){const cv=Math.abs(ang(HD[Math.min(N,i+6)]-HD[Math.max(0,i-6)]));if(Math.random()>.55){r.nc=(40+Math.random()*50)/mist}else if(cv>.06||r.nc<-8){const u=Math.random();rvCrash(r,u<.42?'crowd':u<.72?'roll':'block')}}
   return}
  const c=r.cr;c.t+=h;const moving=c.v>1.2;
  if(moving){c.v*=1-Math.min(1,h*(c.ty==='crowd'?.55:c.ty==='roll'?.8:1.25));c.cs+=c.v*h;c.cl+=(c.tl-c.cl)*Math.min(1,h*1.3);c.yw+=c.spin*h*Math.min(1,c.v/10);
   if(c.ty==='roll')c.roll+=c.sd*h*Math.min(c.v,16)*.42}
  else{c.dn+=h;if(c.ty==='roll'){const tg=Math.round(c.roll/Math.PI)*Math.PI;c.roll+=(tg-c.roll)*Math.min(1,h*3)}c.spin=0}
  const j=Math.min(N-1,c.cs/DS|0),f=Math.min(1,c.cs/DS-j),a=P[j],b=P[j+1],t=TG[j],x=a.x+(b.x-a.x)*f+t.z*c.cl,z=a.z+(b.z-a.z)*f-t.x*c.cl;
  r.s=c.cs;r.v=moving?c.v:0;r.dl=0;
  r.g.position.set(x,a.y+.12+1.15*Math.abs(Math.sin(c.roll/2)),z);r.g.rotation.set(0,HD[j]+c.yw,c.roll);
  try{if(moving&&Math.random()<h*28)xSparks(x,.25,z,0,0,4,1);
   if(c.dn>0||c.v<8){if(Math.random()<h*40)pAdd(SMK,x,a.y+.9,z,(Math.random()-.5)*.6,1.5,(Math.random()-.5)*.6,1.3,.25,.25,.25,.55,2.4);
    if(c.fire&&Math.random()<h*34)pAdd(FIR,x+(Math.random()-.5)*.8,a.y+.7,z+(Math.random()-.5)*.8,(Math.random()-.5)*.5,1.8,(Math.random()-.5)*.5,.6,1,.55,.1,.6,1)}}catch(e){}
  if(moving&&XCR&&c.v>3){for(const o of XCR.p){if(o.st!==0||Math.abs(o.k-j)>8)continue;const dx=o.x-x,dz=o.z-z;if(dx*dx+dz*dz<7.5)rvKnock(r,o)}}
  if(c.dn>c.end){r.cr=null;r.s=c.cs;r.v=0;r.dl=clamp(c.cl-r.ln,-HW*.8,HW*.8);r.yaw=0;r.nc=(100+Math.random()*90)/mist;r.dmg=Math.max(r.dmg||0,.55);r.cool=12}})}
